text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary alert for service=model-service/redwood-mosaic-v2 — canary 5xx rate 6.8% (baseline 0.2), p95 latency jumped to 1.6s. Trigger: health-checks + tokenization errors. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/canary-regressions

sarah: seeing consistent tokenizer errors in canary logs: "Unknown token id 50265" and a bunch of OOM-ish traces on kv-cache warmup.

mike: I'm oncall, looking. Can someone dump the deployed artifact hashes and the manifest?

sarah: manifest shows model_artifact: sha256:aaa111... but the pods report WEIGHTSET_HASH=bbb222... so routing appears to have picked a different bundle. Suspect artifact promotion race.

leo: posted the pod envs and deploy metadata:
```
Pod/redwood-mosaic-v2-canary-7f9  WEIGHTSET_HASH=bbb222...  IMAGE_TAG=latest
Pod/redwood-mosaic-v2-stable-5c1  WEIGHTSET_HASH=aaa111...  IMAGE_TAG=v2.3.1
```

mike: that explains tokenizer mismatch. We need to kill canary routing and rollback. Who can flip the feature flag?

leo: I can flip it. Hitting config API now: `POST /flags/experiment.model.redwood-mosaic-v2 {"value":"stable"}` -> 200 OK.

deploy-bot: Action recorded: trafficRouting(redwood-mosaic-v2) -> stable. Canary traffic 0%.

ashley: support tracking — saw error spike for customer acme-corp (api-key acme-42) starting ~09:11, ~1% of their requests returned 502s. CS alerted.

emma: confirming: Acme reported 502s and some garbled tokenization output in the payload. They routed to our dedicated endpoint; impact window ~09:11-09:14.

mike: initiating rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-mosaic-v2 --to-revision=27` (previous stable).

ops-bot: kube rollout undo accepted for deployment/redwood-mosaic-v2. Terminating canary pods, spinning new pods with artifact sha256:aaa111...

sarah: root cause notes: CI used mutable tag `latest` for model images; artifact promotion job raced with canary rollout, allowing a newer weight bundle (bbb222) to get routed to canary. We'll open PR to pin deploys to SHA and add pre-promote gating.

dave: customer-impact summary: Acme impacted (~1% errors) for ~3 minutes, SLO risk window. CS/AM notified with preliminary note.

leo: oncall handoff remains to @mike at 10:00 but mike is staying on for stabilization. Need a postmortem owner.

mike: I'll take the postmortem. Filing INC-2026-042 now, will include deploy timeline, hashes, config diff, and mitigation steps.

deploy-bot: Canary alert cleared — 5xx rate returned to baseline and p95 latency normalized. :white_check_mark:

ashley: thanks all — follow-up items: pin images by SHA, add canary gating to artifact promotion job, add alert to detect artifact-hash divergence between manifest and pod envs.

mike: noted. Closing pager once incident ticket has initial timeline.
